properties.name: Manitoba and Saskatchewan south of 54°N, Manitoba west of 95.15°W
properties.source: Owner, Oct 11: no Chabad activity found in the far north of the provinces (searched Chabad sites, news and roving-rabbi reports), so north of a line just past the furthest activity is land in no shetach, like the Yukon and NWT north of 63°N. Only the province's own land is cut by it. Saskatchewan: Saskatoon and Regina, and the 2019 roving trip (Rabbi Kats's invitation) as far as Prince Albert and its penitentiary (53.2°N). Owner, Oct 11: Manitoba-Saskatchewan as one rectangle, 54°N across both provinces, its east side Manitoba's straight border with Ontario carried on north (95.15°W).
